scripts.dev: npm run build -w @guiderplan/shared && concurrently -n shared,api,web -c auto "npm run dev -w @guiderplan/shared" "npm run dev -w @guiderplan/api" "npm run dev -w @guiderplan/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @guiderplan/shared && npm run build -w @guiderplan/web && npm run build -w @guiderplan/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @guiderplan/shared && npm run typecheck -w @guiderplan/web -w @guiderplan/api
